calibrate.cmd: SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 NEED=40 SRCS='rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_ctrl_pc.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_afifo.sv' CLK=cks SDCX=physical/s81_ph_views/ctrl/ctrl_pc_tile.sdc POSTCTS=physical/s81_ph_views/ctrl/post_cts_vclk2.tcl bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {NAME}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_ctrl_pc rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/dsfd_ctrl_pc.sv $CL_STOP_AFTER

route.cmd: SDCM=physical/s81_ph_views/common/io_vclk_m_${CK_SS_MEAN}.sdc SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes CORES=16 NEED=40 SRCS='rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_ctrl_pc.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ot_s81ph_afifo.sv' CLK=cks SDCX=physical/s81_ph_views/ctrl/ctrl_pc_tile.sdc POSTCTS=physical/s81_ph_views/ctrl/post_cts_vclk2.tcl bash physical/s81_ph_views/common/route_view.sh {NAME}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} contract dsfd_ctrl_pc rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_ph/ctrl/dsfd_ctrl_pc.sv $CL_STOP_AFTER

budget.reason: S81-PH tile sheet is grade 'target' (no calibration: 467-900 ps); the tiles' measured insertion is far lower (svc_pc 145 ps, ctrl_ctr 61 ps at calibrate), so the sheet SDC would put vclk ~300+ ps late (output hold model -> mass hold buffering). Routed on the calibrated MEASURED insertion (STANDARD FLOW); calib.json is in the record for the sheet re-plan.
